( b ) Warm water fish species or other warm water aquatic animals in ponds, raceways, or other similar structures which discharge at least 30 days per year, but does not include: ( 1 ) Closed ponds which discharge only during periods of excess runoff; or ( 2 ) Facilities which produce less than 45,454 harvest weight kilograms (approximately 100,000 pounds) of aquatic animals per year. “Cold water aquatic animals” include, but are not limited to, the Salmonidae family of fish; e.g., trout and salmon. “Warm water aquatic animals”
